grafts.name: COGNITIVE ACCELERATOR
grafts.benefit: +2 to Knowledge checks. In combat, the first round feels like two rounds for planning purposes (though only normal actions can be taken).

grafts.name: CYBERNETIC LIMB (STANDARD)

grafts.name: DERMAL ARMOR
grafts.benefit: +2 to Armor Score (maximum combined bonus from dermal and worn armor is +10). +2 to Damage Thresholds. Can survive vacuum exposure for up to 5 minutes.

grafts.name: ECHO-LOCATION IMPLANT
grafts.benefit: Ignore penalties from darkness, smoke, or visual obscurement within 20 meters. +2 to checks detecting hidden compartments or passages.

grafts.name: GRAPPLE SYSTEM
grafts.benefit: Can ascend vertical surfaces at normal movement speed. Can pull objects up to 300 kg. Can cross gaps by anchoring and swinging.

grafts.name: INTEGRATED WEAPON SYSTEM
grafts.benefit: Weapon cannot be disarmed. Drawing is Free Action. +1 to attack rolls when using linked targeting systems.

grafts.name: MEDICAL NANITE RESERVOIR
grafts.benefit: Heal 2 HP per Short Rest instead of 1. Automatically stabilized when reduced to 0 HP. Advantage on disease and poison Reaction Rolls.

grafts.name: MEMORY CORE (ADVANCED)
grafts.benefit: +2 to Knowledge checks involving recalled information. Perfect recall of all experiences. Protected memories are immune to telepathic reading or chemical interrogation.

grafts.name: MUSCLE WEAVE (ADVANCED)
grafts.benefit: +2 to Strength for all purposes. Jump distance doubled. Sprint speed increased by 50%. Can maintain maximum exertion for one hour before fatigue.

grafts.name: NEURAL INTERFACE (DIRECT)
grafts.benefit: +2 to checks involving vehicle operation, drone control, or computer hacking when directly connected. Can control up to 3 systems simultaneously.

grafts.name: OPTICAL ENHANCEMENT (ADVANCED)
grafts.benefit: +2 to Awareness checks involving vision; +1 to ranged attack rolls at Long range or beyond.

grafts.name: REACTION BOOSTER
grafts.benefit: +2 to Spotlight contests. Can take one additional Reaction per round (can be used for reactive strikes, defensive actions, or other Reaction abilities).

grafts.name: SENSOR SUITE (STANDARD)
grafts.benefit: Cannot be surprised while conscious; +2 to checks detecting hidden electronic devices.

grafts.name: SKELETAL REINFORCEMENT

grafts.name: TACTICAL HUD INTERFACE
grafts.benefit: +1 to Spotlight contests when working with a linked squad. Allies can share target marking, granting +1 to strike marked targets.

grafts.name: TARGETING RETICLE
grafts.benefit: +2 to ranged attack rolls. Ignore penalties for target movement and environmental conditions.

grafts.benefit: +2 to all checks involving repair, maintenance, or technical work. Always have appropriate basic tools available.

tools.name: AUTO-DOC (PORTABLE)
tools.summary: Allows full surgical treatment in field conditions. Can treat conditions that would normally require a medical facility. The auto-doc has limited supplies for 5 major treatments before restocking (4 Credits). Operator still makes Knowledge Rolls using medical training, but gains advantage and can attempt procedures beyond their training (DC increases by +2).

tools.name: EMERGENCY RESUSCITATION KIT
tools.summary: Can be used on a character who died within the last 5 minutes. Knowledge check (DC 20); on success, the character returns to life at 1 HP with 3 Stress. On failure, the character is not recoverable through normal means. Each additional minute since death adds +2 to the DC.

tools.name: ENGINEERING DRONE (HEAVY)
tools.summary: Can perform repair and construction tasks remotely. Manipulator strength equivalent to Strength +3. Includes integrated basic toolkit. Requires skilled operator to perform complex tasks (operator makes checks at -2 compared to doing the work themselves).

tools.name: HACKING RIG
tools.summary: Required for complex hacking operations. Provides +4 to hacking checks. Can attempt intrusions that would be impossible with lesser equipment. Includes defensive capability against counter-intrusion.

tools.name: IDENTITY MASK
tools.summary: Wearer is another specific person. Requires either direct scanning of the target or detailed reference data. Deception checks to maintain the disguise are made at +4. Close inspection (DC 20) may reveal the mask.

tools.name: NEURAL INHIBITOR
tools.summary: Subject cannot take voluntary actions while inhibitor is active. Removing the inhibitor requires specific authorization or a successful bypass check (DC 20). Forcing removal without bypass causes 2d6 damage to the subject.

tools.name: REGENERATIVE ACCELERANT
tools.summary: Inject as Action. Over the next hour, the character recovers 2d6 HP. However, they must consume food and water equivalent to a full day's rations during this time or suffer 2 Stress from metabolic exhaustion.

tools.name: SENSOR GHOST
tools.summary: Create a false sensor return at chosen location. Sensor systems must beat DC 15 to recognize the ghost as false. Duration: 10 minutes per use; 3 uses before recharge (1 hour).

tools.name: TOOLKIT (MASTER)
tools.summary: Allows repairs on any equipment. Grants +4 to repair checks. Can attempt normally impossible field repairs at Keeper's discretion.
